scope: Assistant reading of the sixteen frozen excerpts; these notes are not supplied to the writer or reviewer and are not independent human expert certification.

material_checks.check: September 21 close: Dow 52,048.83 (+0.7%), S&P 500 7,764.70 (+1.5%), Nasdaq Composite 27,122.09 (+2.3%) at a record. Meta rose 11.4%, AMD about 10%, Intel about 12%; do not treat a few AI stocks as proof of market-wide breadth without an advance/decline measure.

material_checks.topic: Oil, rates and dollar do not tell the same story
material_checks.check: WTI October settled at $95.78 (-4.51%); Brent November at $100.34 (-3.4%). A possible US-Iran meeting and reported restraint on Houthi strikes are not a ceasefire. Regional exports were reported near 80% of prewar levels despite Saudi pipeline closure. Ten-year Treasury yields differ across reports (4.95% versus 4.972%), while the dollar rose versus euro and yen in one source; date and basis must be clear.

Muse overtook ChatGPT in one US iOS free-app ranking, with 730,000 downloads in about five days and more than 2.5 million cumulative by Monday; staggered platform launches limit competitor comparison. Downloads do not establish paying users or cash flow. AMD crossed a reported $1tn market value, not $1tn revenue.

Bessent reported a new bilateral AI-risk dialogue, with a November follow-up planned, alongside unresolved trade/export-control issues and a separate warning about service to Iranian airlines in two days. A summit, friendly ceremony or official warning is not a new trade agreement or implemented sanction. The US-Japan-Korea foreign ministers' supply-chain statement is a separate diplomatic action; it did not name China directly.

The ECB announced Pontes already launched for wholesale tokenized-asset settlement in central-bank money, with an initial group onboarded and full implementation expected by 2028. It is neither a retail CBDC nor evidence of immediate crypto-token returns.

material_checks.topic: Energy reconstruction proposal and corporate M&A
material_checks.check: The reported US $5bn plus requested regional $5bn reconstruction fund remains a proposal, with participation and timing unresolved; damaged energy capacity can outlast a strait reopening. Paramount's settlement removes a hurdle to a reported $110bn Warner Bros merger, subject to commitments, but should displace main macro drivers only if its market relevance is explained.

lower_priority_or_context: Iranian media's reported delegation visa refusal and a UK human-rights speech should not be transformed into a new trade or oil policy without a specific market link.
The short oil and US-close wire updates duplicate fuller market stories and should not count as independent confirmation.
Any cryptocurrency 24-hour change needs its quoted observation time; it is not a US equity close.
